status: PROPOSED (isolated branch; not wired to any publisher; needs ratification)
scope: TARGET-scoped bowfisher readiness. Non-target species (protected, policy-held, saltwater, look-alikes) are knowledge only and cannot move this score. Not an average of species scores.

dimensions.label: How well we understand where and when the target species move
dimensions.scale: mean species-v2 overallExact over target species; an unassessed target counts 0 (measured)
dimensions.bowfisherValue: directly sets how good the search advice can be

dimensions.label: Condition families the target rules respond to
dimensions.scale: mean over targets of families covered (temperature, trend/crossing, stage/hydrology, clarity, daypart) / 5 x 10
dimensions.bowfisherValue: more covered conditions = fewer conditions where the Brain has nothing to say

dimensions.label: Independent inspected evidence behind target rules
dimensions.scale: mean counting streams per usable rule, capped at 3, /3 x 10
dimensions.bowfisherValue: how likely the advice is right

dimensions.label: Target rules approved by an independent reviewer
dimensions.bowfisherValue: catches mistakes the author cannot see

dimensions.label: Target rules that apply to Southeast reservoirs
dimensions.scale: (TRANSFERS + 0.5 x PARTIAL) / usable x 10; general behaviour is never erased by low regional confidence, this only measures applicability
dimensions.bowfisherValue: whether the advice fits the lake being fished

dimensions.label: Per-lake Biological State exists
dimensions.bowfisherValue: advice for a specific lake right now

dimensions.label: Consumed by Sector Intelligence or a customer path

reportedNotScored: registry completeness (every species assessed or explicitly NOT_ASSESSED)
honestyUnknown: enforced by tests and gates (no fabricated inputs, UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN, snippet-only never counts), not by points
